source: i want to make a cute cottage core place with a cottage in a forest full of pastel flowers

image_prompt.text: The cottage itself as the visible anchor of the clearing, seen from anywhere in the forest
Walkable routes threading the forest so movement toward the cottage has an obvious grain
Composed views of the cottage framed by trees and flowers
dense forest surrounding the cottage on all sides

notes: No genre: this is a place and a mood, not a game type, and all five axes stay at their defaults.
The cottage was not made enterable - the prompt never says the player goes inside, and doing so would add an interior pass.

open_questions.ask: Does the player go inside the cottage, or is it scenery only?
Is there anything to do here, or is it purely a place to walk around and look at?

theme: Cottagecore - pastel, soft and storybook cute (nearest listed vocabulary: Stylized / Toon)

coverage_missing.ask: Is there any activity here, or is it a showcase place?
Is this a small clearing you can see across, or a forest you can wander in?

answers.ask: Does the player go inside the cottage, or is it scenery only?
answers.answer: The cottage should be scenery only; keep the build focused on the exterior forest setting.

answers.ask: Is there anything to do here, or is it purely a place to walk around and look at?
answers.answer: It is purely a peaceful place to walk around and look at the cottage, forest, and pastel flowers.
